blocks.title: Read in Daily Life
blocks.passage:
Subject: Your university password expires in 7 days

Dear user,

Your university password will expire on November 20. To avoid losing access to email, Wi-Fi and course materials, please change it before that date using the Self-Service portal.

New passwords must contain at least 12 characters, including one number and one symbol. If you forget your password, you can reset it online only if you have registered a mobile number. Otherwise, visit the IT help desk in Room A-020 with your student card. The help desk is open Monday to Friday, 9:00-17:00.

IT Services

items.q: Why did IT Services send this message?
options: To announce a new Wi-Fi network
To remind users to change a password that will expire
To ask users for their mobile numbers
items.explain: Asunto y primer párrafo: la contraseña caduca el 20 de noviembre.

items.q: Which is required in a new password?
options: At least 8 characters and no symbols
At least 12 characters, one number and one symbol
items.explain: «at least 12 characters, including one number and one symbol».

items.q: What should a user do who forgot the password and has no registered mobile number?
options: Go to the IT help desk with a student card
Send an email to the professor
items.explain: «Otherwise, visit the IT help desk… with your student card».

blocks.title: Write an Email
blocks.prompt:
**Situation.** Dr. Patel's research group is looking for student volunteers. You study environmental engineering and would like to help.

**Write an email to Dr. Patel.** In your email:
- Introduce yourself and say why you are interested.
- Describe one relevant skill or experience.
- Ask how many hours per week the volunteers are expected to work.
blocks.model:
Dear Dr. Patel,

My name is Lucía Gómez, and I am a second-year student of environmental engineering. I am writing because I am very interested in your research on water quality, and I would like to volunteer in your group.

Last summer I worked in a laboratory where I tested river samples and recorded the results in spreadsheets, so I am comfortable with basic lab procedures and data entry.

Could you tell me how many hours per week volunteers are expected to work? I would also be glad to send my CV.

Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
Lucía Gómez

questions.q: What is your favorite way to learn something new?
questions.model: I learn best by doing. For example, when I wanted to learn programming, I built a small project instead of only watching videos. Making mistakes showed me what I did not understand yet.

questions.q: Do you think students should be required to take courses outside their major? Why?
questions.model: Yes, I do, because other fields teach different ways of thinking. For instance, an engineering student who takes a writing course learns to explain ideas clearly, which is useful in any career.
